# Now 2.13.22
- Smoother open/close for the full-screen view: instead of the album art and lyrics reflowing as the window grows out of the overlay, the window now grows from the overlay's spot as a clean backdrop and the content fades in once it settles full-screen. Closing reverses it — the content fades out, then the window shrinks back into the overlay's corner.

# Now 2.13.21
- New: Now can pause browser music (YouTube Music / Spotify web) while the microphone is in use — dictation apps like Wispr Flow, or calls — the way Apple Music ducks on its own. It resumes automatically a moment after the mic frees. Native apps like Apple Music are left alone since they already handle this themselves. - Turn it on or off in Settings → Sources → Microphone (on by default). Any manual play/pause/skip cancels an in-progress auto-pause, so Now never fights you.

# Now 2.13.20
- Fixed: quitting the browser mid-song (without pausing first) now stops the overlay properly. Previously it kept showing the song as playing and the lyrics kept scrolling, because the app trusted the browser's last-known state and never noticed the browser was gone. It now detects that the browser hosting playback has quit and pauses immediately. - Also fixed a related issue where the lyrics/progress could keep advancing for a moment after playback was paused.
